title: DataCore Product
description: A product within a domain. A product is a coherent commercial or thematic bundle of datasets (e.g., 'VN Equity', 'VN Macroeconomic Indicators'). Datasets reference their parent product via the `product` field.

id.description: Stable machine identifier for the product, slug-style (e.g., 'vn-equity').

name.description: Human-readable display name for the product.

domain.description: The id of the parent domain. Must match a value from domain.schema.json.

description.description: What this product is, who maintains it, and what kind of datasets it bundles.

coverage.description: Aggregate coverage of all datasets that belong to this product.

end.description: Latest date covered, or 'rolling' if continuously updated.

geographies.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes covered by the product.

tags.description: Freeform tags for search and filtering.
